title: Spiced Yellow Curry with Manchego Crust
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired dish with a crunchy manchego crust, perfect for a dinner party. The spiced yellow curry is made with a blend of warming spices and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: Spiced Indian Flatbread
ingredients.notes: available at most Indian grocery stores

instructions: Prepare the yellow curry paste according to package instructions.
Cut the spiced Indian flatbread into small pieces and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the curry paste over medium heat.
Add the coconut milk and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the curry sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
While the curry sauce is simmering, prepare the manchego crust.
In a bowl, mix together the shredded manchego cheese and a pinch of salt.
Add the chopped cilantro to the bowl and stir to combine.
To assemble the dish, place the spiced Indian flatbread pieces in the bottom of a baking dish.
Spoon the yellow curry sauce over the flatbread pieces.
Top the curry sauce with the manchego crust mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
